title: Finding What Matters: Anchoring Context Knowledge with Evolving Indices for Iterative Retrieval
authors: Mingyan Wu; Zhenghao Liu; Xinze Li; Yuqing Lan; Yukun Yan; Shuo Wang; Cheng Yang; Minghe Yu; Zheni Zeng; Maosong Sun
why_relevant: Proposes an iterative RAG method that anchors key evidence to mitigate noise accumulation across retrieval steps in multi-hop QA, addressing context noise and lost-in-the-middle issues.
why_not_or_caveat: Primarily a multi-hop QA performance method; robustness to noise is a motivation but not rigorously benchmarked under adversarial or strongly unreliable evidence.
